Hi Dylan —

Acme's compliance team is wrapping up our SOC 2 vendor review and has a couple of follow-ups after reviewing the summary you shared last week. They asked if we can get the full penetration test report (signed), the scope matrix used for the engagement, and a sample of access logs and remediation evidence for the high/critical findings.
